title: Rating Manual — RentGuard Renters Policy Annual Premium
content:
## Rule

The annual premium of a RentGuard Renters Policy is computed in this order.

1. **Contents charge.** The Coverage C limit divided by 1,000, multiplied by the tier's contents rate per 1,000 USD, by the territory factor of the policy's rating territory and by the deductible factor of its deductible.
2. **Subtotal.** The contents charge, plus the liability charge for the policy's liability limit, plus — when a co-insured roommate is on the policy — the tier's annual co-insured charge.
3. *Retired clause — no longer in force.* "The discount percentage is the autopay discount percentage when the billing plan is the monthly EFT plan plus the multi-policy discount percentage when the multi-policy discount applies, and 0 otherwise." This clause has been withdrawn and superseded by the current basis for a multi-policy discount that restarts during the renters term.
4. **Annual premium.** The subtotal reduced by the discount percentage, rounded half-up to the cent, and never less than the tier's minimum annual premium. Only this final figure is rounded; the contents charge and the subtotal are carried unrounded.
5. **Term premium.** The policy's term premium always holds the annual premium at the policy's current rating: it is set at binding and at renewal and is restated after every midterm re-rating.
6. **Renewal offer.** The same arithmetic is used for the renewal offer, on the rating in force on the renewal offer date.

The contents rate, minimum annual premium, autopay discount, multi-policy discount and co-insured charge are the figures of the policy's own tier.

## Rating tables

| Territory | CMH | CLE | CIN | TOL | NEO | SEO |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Territory factor | 1.00 | 1.12 | 1.06 | 0.97 | 0.94 | 0.89 |

| Deductible (USD) | 100 | 250 | 500 | 1000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Deductible factor | 1.12 | 1.06 | 1.00 | 0.91 |

| Liability limit (USD) | 100000 | 300000 | 500000 | 1000000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Liability charge (USD) | 14.00 | 26.00 | 38.00 | 61.00 |

## Worked examples (hypothetical policies)

**Example 1.** RentGuard HO-4 Premier, contents rate 6.47, Coverage C 30000, territory CLE, deductible 500, liability 300000, no co-insured, and — as a hypothetical input — a discount percentage of 0.
- Contents charge: 30 multiplied by 6.47 is 194.10; multiplied by 1.12 is 217.392; multiplied by 1.00 stays 217.392.
- Subtotal: 217.392 plus 26.00 is 243.392.
- Annual premium: 243.392 rounded half-up is 243.39, which is above the minimum of 176.00, so the annual premium is 243.39.

**Example 2.** RentGuard HO-4 Starter, contents rate 4.82, Coverage C 15000, territory TOL, deductible 1000, liability 100000, discount percentage 0 (hypothetical input).
- Contents charge: 15 multiplied by 4.82 is 72.30; multiplied by 0.97 is 70.131; multiplied by 0.91 is 63.81921.
- Subtotal: 63.81921 plus 14.00 is 77.81921, rounded 77.82.
- The tier's minimum annual premium of 118.00 is higher, so the annual premium is 118.00.

superseded_clauses: The discount percentage is autopay_discount_pct when the billing plan is monthly_eft plus multi_policy_discount_pct when renters_agg_bundle_discount applies, and 0 otherwise.
